description: Single-band equalizer with seven filter shapes, a frequency from 30Hz to 14000Hz and an adjustable bandwidth

params.text: Sets the frequency the filter works around, 30Hz to 14000Hz, with the frequency in use shown in the green display
Picks the filter shape in whole steps, low pass, high pass, band pass, notch, peak, low shelf and high shelf, with the name shown in the green display
Sets the width of the band worked on, 0.1 to 6, a low value giving a wide band and a high value a narrow one

inputs.text: Shifts the filter frequency, 10V adding the whole 30Hz to 14000Hz span to the FREQ knob and -10V taking it away
Shifts the Q, 10V adding the whole 0.1 to 6 span to the Q knob and -10V taking it away
